title: ReCAST: Reward Credit Assignment across Timesteps for Online Diffusion Reinforcement
abstract: arXiv:2609.13425v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training diffusion models with multiple rewards requires distinguishing user preference from reward informativeness. User preference determines how much each reward should contribute to the overall objective; reward informativeness determines when its feedback is useful during denoising. Some rewards can meaningfully evaluate a sample as soon as global structure emerges, but others become informative only when the sample is nearly clean. To address both questions jointly, we propose ReCAST (Reward Credit ASsignment across T}imesteps), the first method, to our knowledge, for per-reward, timestep-dependent credit assignment in diffusion reward fine-tuning. ReCAST separates user preferences from temporal allocation through a reward-by-timestep weight matrix $W$, whose row sums match the user-specified reward budgets $\lambda$, while its column sums are equal, assigning the same total weight to each denoising step. translated_title: ReCAST：面向在线扩散强化学习的跨时间步奖励信用分配
translated_abstract: 使用多奖励训练扩散模型需要区分用户偏好与奖励信息量这两个不同的因素。用户偏好决定了每个奖励应对总体目标贡献多少；而奖励信息量则决定了其反馈在去噪过程中的哪个时刻是有用的。有些奖励在全局结构一出现时就能有效评估样本，但另一些奖励只有在样本接近完全清晰时才变得有信息量。为了同时解决这两个问题，我们提出了ReCAST（跨时间步的奖励信用分配），据我们所知，这是首个在扩散模型奖励微调中实现按奖励、按时间步进行信用分配的方法。ReCAST通过一个“奖励×时间步”的权重矩阵W将用户偏好与时间上的分配解耦开来：该矩阵的行和与用户指定的奖励预算λ相匹配，而其列和相等，即为每个去噪步骤分配相同的总权重。在这些边际约束下……
tldr: ReCAST是首个在扩散模型奖励微调中实现按奖励、按时间步进行信用分配的方法，通过“奖励×时间步”权重矩阵将用户偏好与去噪过程中的奖励时间分配解耦，解决了多奖励训练中不同奖励在不同去噪阶段信息量不同的问题。
en_tdlr: ReCAST is the first method for per-reward, timestep-dependent credit assignment in diffusion reward fine-tuning, which decouples user preferences from temporal reward allocation via a reward-by-timestep weight matrix, addressing how different rewards become informative at different denoising stages in multi-reward training.
